profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer combining exceptional people skills and emotional intelligence with a love of technology, innovation and learning. Thrives in team environment. Passionate about improving how things work and helping others succeed.

Skills:
Java, Rails, React, Javascript, C#

positions.title: Manager/Sole Proprietor
positions.description: Secure and manage private loans that help people overlooked by traditional financial institutions to achieve their goals

positions.title: Student Software Engineer
positions.description:
3 month in-depth program
10 hrs a day
Learned Ruby on Rails, Javascript, and React
Link Projects

positions.title: Engineering Technician I
positions.description:
Member of team that designed and prototyped a radio linked network of devices
Worked in Agile development with daily meetings
Designed graphs displaying terabytes of data using C# and XAML

positions.title: Director of Logistics
positions.description:
Arranged for and coordinated multiple venues and transportation for all events, sponsors and over 1000 attendees
Directed team of volunteers under time and budget pressures

positions.title: Activities Director
positions.description: Planned, organized and implemented activities to boost attendees’ creativity and relieve mental fatigue

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
Highest upsell rate and multiple employee-of-the-month awards
Oversaw accounting and inventory software integration resulting in increased accuracy and efficiency 
Analyzed and managed transactional, historical, and inventory data for better knowledge of product demand
